Who this is for

Built for people and businesses moving money across borders.

BLK.FX works with internationally active businesses, finance teams and founders managing currency exposure, as well as private clients making significant overseas transfers.

Importers & exporters

Buying or selling in another currency on a schedule. Rates agreed up front and forwards available so a shipment's margin isn't decided by the market on the day it lands.

Ecommerce

Collecting in USD, EUR or other currencies from marketplaces and payment providers, then converting back without losing a cut on every single transfer.

SaaS & tech

Billing international customers, paying overseas contractors or a distributed team, and holding revenue in the currency it was earned in.

Professional services

Client funds, disbursements and fees crossing borders, handled with the compliance work done properly and a named person to call.

Finance teams

A written FX policy, a margin you can put in a board pack, and someone who explains the exposure in plain terms rather than jargon.

Private clients & family offices

Property purchases, school fees, and large personal transfers, with a rate fixed before you commit and support outside normal office hours.

Infrastructure

The right infrastructure for the job.

We aren't a one-size-fits-all provider, and we don't rely on a single platform. Instead, we operate as your currency and payments concierge, drawing on a trusted network of:

Learn about FinTech providers → Talk about partners →
  • Tier 1 FinTech platforms
  • Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs)
  • Liquidity providers and FX brokers
  • Global payment gateways and acquirers

This means:

  • Fast, secure settlements
  • Regulatory confidence
  • Freedom to scale
  • Tailored infrastructure based on your needs
What you get

What you get with BLK.FX.

The same six things, on every service, every time.

Same-day payments

Faster Payments, SEPA, SWIFT and ACH from one place, moved the same day in most of our 35+ currencies.

Competitive FX margin

An average margin of 0.5 to 0.7%, not the 2 to 4% a bank quietly takes, and agreed before you trade.

Forward contracts

Lock in a rate before you pay or get paid, so a currency move between now and completion can't break your number.

Named IBAN accounts

Accounts opened in your own name, so you can receive, hold and convert without losing out on every single conversion.

A named account manager

One person who knows your business and answers, not a ticket queue and a different agent every time you call.

24/7 support

A direct line when something is time-sensitive, not just office hours.
